title: AAAAHHHHHHHHHH
text:
AAAAHHHHHHHHHH. PSSSSSSSST THE 78” MEASUREMENT DOES NOT INCLUDE THE TASSELS.
just wanted to put that out there...I’m not yelling i promise.
If you’re looking for a curtain that is EXACTLY 78” or it won’t work (like I was) this isn’t it, queen. If you’re looking for a cute curtain that’s like 82”, than you are in luck my friend!

So I really like this curtain BUT the dimensions (as far as I read) do not include the tassel length. I was looking for a 78” curtain which this is PLUS the tassels which are themselves about 3-4 inches long...I’m pretty bummed. It looks ok but the tassels drag on the ground a lot.
Overall, cute curtain. Wack dimension listing.
